import hashlib, io, json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
oldsha = "360da646892e46545ca70e8838bc3a2a89e460a3"
git = ["git", "-c", "safe.directory=" + root.as_posix()]
archive = subprocess.run(git + ["archive", "--format=zip", oldsha, "src/card_market_tracker"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="cmt-rw01-independent-qa-original-") as temporary:
    folder = Path(temporary)
    zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)).extractall(folder)
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", PYTHONPATH=str(folder / "src"))
    origin = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", "import card_market_tracker.watchlist_alerts.storage as s; print(s.__file__)"], cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    assert str(folder).lower() in origin.stdout.lower()
    args = [sys.executable, "scripts/p8c_rw01_qa_probe.py", "--fixtures", "tests/fixtures", "--timeout", "5"]
    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode == 1
    assert result.stderr.rstrip().endswith("AssertionError: expected identity_conflict")
    safe = lambda value: value.replace(str(root), "<REPOSITORY>").replace(str(folder), "<ORIGINAL-SOURCE-TEMP>")
    print(json.dumps({"candidate_sha": oldsha, "source_archive_sha256": hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest(), "original_package_import_verified": True, "command": ["<PYTHON>", *args[1:]], "exit_code": result.returncode, "stdout": safe(result.stdout), "stderr": safe(result.stderr), "result": "EXPECTED_FAIL"}, sort_keys=True))
